title: Wire UI runtime durable reasoning records

records.situation: A cold browser on GPRS needs the Wire UI runtime.
records.reasoning: Remove request round trips first: serve one content-addressed gzip runtime, then acquire only authorised cache-miss definitions/resources. Do not change journey/business semantics to compensate for bandwidth.

records.situation: A returning browser on GPRS reconnects.
records.reasoning: Reuse immutable runtime, definitions and approved resources; fetch only fresh server-authoritative snapshot/deltas. Never persist live authoritative session state as a cache optimisation.

records.situation: CREATE_INSTANCE arrives before its authorised immutable definition on a cold client.
records.reasoning: Hold the ordered patch behind the definition barrier, request the exact definition, then replay. Do not force resync unless there is a genuine revision gap.

records.situation: The user acts on revision 41 after the server has advanced to revision 42.
records.reasoning: Send renderedRevision=41 and let the server detect/reject or explicitly handle stale context. The browser must not rewrite the action as current.

records.situation: WebSocket disappears while a Queue Fabric package is claimed.
records.reasoning: Release/reclaim transport work; do not increment semantic backout as though the application rejected the message.

records.situation: Browser semantic dispatch throws for a delivered Queue Fabric message.
records.reasoning: NACK the opaque delivery through the gateway so Queue Fabric records semantic rejection/backout; claim tokens remain private.

records.situation: QueueWorkPackage sequence jumps on one browser queue because other manager queues received packages.
records.reasoning: Do not infer missing browser messages. Use the gateway's contiguous per-access-point deliverySequence; retain QueueWorkPackage sequence only as provenance.

records.situation: A customer-facing definition requires an approved ResourceRef but no resolver/authority is available.
records.reasoning: Fail closed. Do not invent Continue/Send/headline/body copy or derive a URL from the resource identity.

records.situation: An exact resource has standard and constrained approved representations.
records.reasoning: The resolver may choose the constrained representation for GPRS only if both belong to the same exact resourceId@version/manifest; it may not rewrite content or change proposition identity.

records.situation: Backend assessment decides an approved credit-card proposition is appropriate.
records.reasoning: Project the exact approved ResourceRef and semantic actions. Builder/renderer do not author the marketing copy or image; the Resource Authority owns them.

records.situation: Chat starts after support/error/cancellation-related application activity.
records.reasoning: Use an authorised positive-list observation subscription and purpose-scoped downstream interpretation. Do not dump generic browsing history or enable capture-everything analytics.

records.situation: An authorised machine access point selects AI_AGENT_OPTIMISED.
records.reasoning: Change semantic presentation projection only. Keep the same server business objects, legal/commercial actions, Queue Fabric and authority checks; do not create a bot-only transaction API.

records.situation: A semantic view is rendered in Swing rather than a browser.
records.reasoning: Keep journey/definition/revision/action semantics unchanged. Swing-specific EDT/JComponent mechanics belong to the Swing renderer sphere, not server/business logic.

records.situation: Browser submits price, currency, sale identity or other server-owned fields.
records.reasoning: Treat browser material as untrusted input/correlation only. Re-resolve authoritative business values server-side before transaction dispatch.

records.situation: Two chats produce the same component/version name with different content.
records.reasoning: Hash and inspect both, preserve unique capabilities, make an explicit reconciliation cut and requalify. Never pick one merely because it arrived later.

records.situation: Two renderers appear visually correct but differ in semantic output.
records.reasoning: Run the canonical renderer-conformance fixture and compare normalized semantic transcripts. Presentation differences are permitted; identity, revisions, actions, resource authority, observation semantics and fail-closed behaviour are not.

records.situation: A virtualized renderer needs rows/items not currently projected.
records.reasoning: Emit semantic RangeRequested(start,count). The renderer reports bounded demand only; application/server/source authority decides what to fetch/project. Never turn visible row ordinal into application identity.

records.situation: A renderer adds visual status chips, colours, cards or platform-native styling.
records.reasoning: Treat styling as presentation only. It may expose already-projected status/accessibility material but must not create/deny actions or infer lifecycle/business truth.

records.situation: Archive name/qualification and internal VERSION/README disagree.
records.reasoning: Preserve exact artifact digest and report the mismatch as owning-package debt. Do not rewrite provenance in a continuity sphere or infer a new version from filename alone.

records.situation: HTTP page loads and WebSocket upgrades, but projected UI is incomplete.
records.reasoning: Report transport/bootstrap stages separately. Wire view readiness requires profile/definition/resource readiness plus authoritative snapshot/revision synchronization; WebSocket 101 is not semantic readiness.

records.situation: A team wants to replace the static/bootstrap front.
records.reasoning: Node, ooRexx HTTP/HTTPS or another conforming front may serve assets/bootstrap. The front must not become a second application/business API or acquire state authority.

records.situation: A renderer receives a ResourceRef for customer-facing material.
records.reasoning: Treat Resource Editor/Resource Contract publication as authority. Resolve and verify the exact published identity/bytes; do not author, rewrite, choose arbitrary URLs or synthesize missing copy in the renderer.
